research.title: 数据中心节能与绿色计算
research.summary: 从服务器功耗到数据中心能效，研究计算与能源的协同优化。
topics: 服务器与集群能效建模
数据中心热管理与制冷优化
AI 算力能效评测与基准
功耗预测与能源管理

research.title: 云计算调度与算力管理
research.summary: 面向云计算与 AI 集群，让异构计算资源更高效地服务复杂工作负载。
topics: GPU / NPU 异构集群调度
虚拟机与容器资源管理
深度学习作业共享与干扰建模
作业抢占、排队确定性与碎片整理

research.title: 大模型优化与应用
research.summary: 围绕模型训练、推理服务与应用评测，研究资源高效的大模型技术。
topics: 资源高效的模型微调
推理服务效率与用户体验
文档检索增强生成与评测
多模态模型及领域应用

research.title: 时序预测模型与应用
research.summary: 以轻量化建模和周期结构学习，理解复杂多元序列并预测未来。
topics: 轻量化长序列预测
多元依赖与周期模式建模
云负载与服务器功耗预测
面向真实场景的时序模型

research.title: 边缘智能与联邦学习
research.summary: 连接端、边、云上的异构设备，探索协同计算与分布式学习。
topics: 端边云资源协同与任务卸载
异构设备运行时间预测
联邦学习通信与客户端选择
个性化学习与模型安全

papers.name: Concord
papers.title: Concord: A GPU cluster scheduler with enhanced interference profiling and asymmetric job packing
papers.authors: Xinhua Wang, Weiwei Lin, Haijie Wu, Jidong Zhai, Keqin Li
papers.summary: 通过干扰建模与非对称作业组合，优化 GPU 集群中的资源共享与调度。正式卷期为 2026 年 10 月。

papers.name: ExFairS
papers.title: Experiential Fairness: Bridging the Gap Between User Experience and Resource-Centric Fairness in Online LLM Services
papers.authors: Jiahua Huang, Wentai Wu, Yongheng Liu, Guozhi Liu, Yang Wang, Weiwei Lin
papers.summary: 从用户体验出发重新定义大模型服务公平性，并设计轻量级推理调度框架。

papers.name: NoSPF
papers.title: NoSPF: Non-Stationary Long-Term Power Consumption Forecasting for Servers in Cloud Data Centers
papers.authors: Ruichao Mo, Weiwei Lin, Shengsheng Lin, Simon Fong, Keqin Li
papers.summary: 以分层优化刻画功耗序列中的平稳与非平稳成分，研究服务器长期功耗预测。

papers.name: SparseTSF
papers.title: SparseTSF: Lightweight and Robust Time Series Forecasting via Sparse Modeling
papers.authors: Shengsheng Lin, Weiwei Lin, Wentai Wu, Haojun Chen, C. L. Philip Chen
papers.summary: 在稀疏时序建模框架中进一步研究轻量化与鲁棒性；为 ICML 2024 工作的期刊扩展版。

papers.name: TQNet
papers.title: Temporal Query Network for Efficient Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.authors: Shengsheng Lin, Haojun Chen, Haijie Wu, Chunyun Qiu, Weiwei Lin
papers.summary: 以时间查询捕获全局周期模式，学习多元时间序列中的依赖关系。

papers.name: CycleNet
papers.title: CycleNet: Enhancing Time Series Forecasting through Modeling Periodic Patterns
papers.authors: Shengsheng Lin, Weiwei Lin, Xinyi Hu, Wentai Wu, Ruichao Mo, Haocheng Zhong
papers.summary: 显式建模周期模式，通过周期与残差分解增强时序预测。

papers.name: Double-Bench
papers.title: Are We on the Right Way for Assessing Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation?
papers.authors: Wenxuan Shen, Mingjia Wang, Yaochen Wang, Dongping Chen, Junjie Yang, Yao Wan, Weiwei Lin
papers.summary: 围绕文档检索增强生成构建评测基准，检查文档 RAG 系统的评估方式。

papers.name: SegRNN
papers.title: SegRNN: Segment Recurrent Neural Network for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
papers.authors: Shengsheng Lin, Weiwei Lin, Wentai Wu, Feiyu Zhao, Ruichao Mo, Haotong Zhang
papers.summary: 通过分段迭代与并行多步预测，构建高效的循环时序预测网络。

papers.name: Kairos
papers.title: Kairos: Deterministic Scheduling Enhanced by User Collaboration for Deep Learning Workloads
papers.authors: Xinhua Wang, Weiwei Lin, Ruichao Mo, Guozhi Liu, Haijie Wu, Shengjun Tang
papers.summary: 结合用户协作与抢占式调度，改善深度学习作业排队时间的可预测性。

papers.name: AdaptiveFL
papers.title: AdaptiveFL: Communication-Adaptive Federated Learning Under Dynamic Bandwidth
papers.authors: Guozhi Liu, Weiwei Lin, Tiansheng Huang, Fang Shi, Wentai Wu, Li Shen
papers.summary: 面向动态带宽环境研究通信自适应联邦学习。

papers.name: Device Runtime Prediction
papers.title: Prediction of Heterogeneous Device Task Runtime Based on Edge Server-Oriented Deep Neuro-Fuzzy System
papers.authors: Haijie Wu, Weiwei Lin, Wangbo Shen, Xiumin Wang, C. L. Philip Chen, Keqin Li
papers.summary: 面向边缘服务器预测异构设备任务运行时间，为协同调度提供支持。

papers.name: MSCNet
papers.title: MSCNet: Multi-Scale Network with Convolutions for Long-term Cloud Workload Prediction
papers.authors: Feiyu Zhao, Weiwei Lin, Shengsheng Lin, Shaomin Tang, Keqin Li
papers.summary: 融合多尺度建模与卷积，研究长时间跨度的云工作负载预测。

papers.name: TEVP
papers.title: Energy-aware virtual machine placement based on a holistic thermal model for cloud data centers
papers.authors: Jianpeng Lin, Weiwei Lin, Wentai Wu, Wenjun Lin, Keqin Li
papers.summary: 结合整体热模型研究虚拟机放置，联合考虑计算与制冷能耗。

papers.name: SparseTSF
papers.title: SparseTSF: Modeling Long-term Time Series Forecasting with 1k Parameters
papers.authors: Shengsheng Lin, Weiwei Lin, Wentai Wu, Haojun Chen, Junjie Yang
papers.summary: 通过跨周期稀疏预测分离周期性与趋势，以极少参数完成长时间序列预测。

papers.name: T-Vaccine
papers.title: Targeted Vaccine: Safety Alignment for Large Language Models Against Harmful Fine-Tuning via Layer-Wise Perturbation
papers.authors: Guozhi Liu, Weiwei Lin, Qi Mu, Tiansheng Huang, Ruichao Mo, Yuren Tao, Li Shen
papers.summary: 通过针对安全关键层的扰动，提高大模型面对有害微调时的安全性与资源效率。

papers.name: Cloud Datasets Survey
papers.title: Public Datasets for Cloud Computing: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.authors: Guozhi Liu, Weiwei Lin, Haotong Zhang, Jianpeng Lin, Shaoliang Peng, Keqin Li
papers.summary: 系统梳理云计算公开数据集，为资源管理、调度与系统研究提供数据参考。
